descripcion: Business management platform with multi-warehouse inventory control and invoicing.
tagline: A lightweight ERP for small businesses: sales, stock and e-invoicing in one place.
problema: The client tracked sales and inventory in separate spreadsheets: monthly stock mismatches and hand-written invoices.
solucion: Spring Boot API with clean architecture, transactional inventory movements and an integrated invoicing module; React web dashboard.
uso: Sales and warehouse staff use it daily: they record sales from the web dashboard, stock is deducted instantly and the invoice is generated when the sale is confirmed.
resultado: Monthly closing went from 3 days to 2 hours and stock mismatches were virtually eliminated.

descripcion: Role-based access control with fine-grained permissions, auditing and SSO.
tagline: A reusable authentication and authorization service for internal applications.
problema: Every internal system implemented its own login and permissions, with duplicated and inconsistent rules.
solucion: Central NestJS service with RBAC, JWT tokens and a React admin console to manage roles.
uso: Internal applications delegate login to the central service; administrators assign roles and permissions from the console without touching code.
resultado: 4 applications migrated to the central service and user onboarding cut from 1 day to minutes.
